claims.statement: Poland requires authorization for online mutual betting and publishes a list of entities permitted to offer it, giving a narrow, identifiable regulated customer set.

EU recommendations address time-out, self-exclusion, and reporting of protection measures, while WHO identifies binding limits, effective self-exclusion, and operator regulation as relevant harm-prevention measures.
Hypothesis: operators, platform vendors, or their auditors will pay for repeatable evidence that controls work end to end and for confidential peer benchmarks on remediation speed.

contrary_evidence: Operators and platform suppliers already run internal compliance tests and may resist independent comparisons.
WHO cautions that voluntary responsible-gambling measures can have poor uptake or effectiveness, so a process seal alone may not improve outcomes.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: sell a bounded synthetic-control audit through one platform vendor or compliance firm, then convert annual release monitoring.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 5 Polish contracts in year 2, 25 EU contracts in year 4, and 70 operators/vendors in year 6 at 120000 PLN average annual revenue yields 8.4M PLN ARR. At 3-5x ARR and 50-65% founder ownership, equity can exceed 5M PLN, contingent on real safety outcomes and EU channel distribution.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 12-20 hours/week initially; legal, public-health, and audit experts remain independent contractors rather than founder substitutes.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 65-78% after specialist review, secure test environments, and governance costs.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 9-15 months at 30000-60000 PLN enterprise acquisition cost and 60000-120000 PLN first-year contract value.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 40000-90000 PLN annual operator contract plus 15000-30000 PLN per major remediation retest.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: annual audit and continuous releases repeat; remediation history raises switching costs, with target annual retention above 90% after acceptance.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Cross-platform control-failure taxonomy, remediation-time outcomes, and longitudinal evidence accepted by auditors
fingerprint.customer: Poland-licensed online bookmakers and the platform vendors or auditors serving them
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Gaming-platform vendors, compliance auditors, insurer requirements, and aggregate public safety reports
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Synthetic end-to-end control testing, remediation record, audit packet, and protected peer benchmark
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Operator or vendor pays for an assessment cycle and annual continuous-control evidence subscription
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Control release, annual audit, material platform change, regulator query, or detected control failure

founder_fit: Combines personal domain familiarity with data-science control testing.
Narrow regulated B2B market supports targeted, non-public-facing sales.
Automated test harnesses can be built part-time using synthetic accounts and agreed test environments.
A mission focused on harm prevention channels the domain interest toward a lawful protective product.
risks: Industry capture or a cosmetic seal could worsen harm; governance must include independent public-health expertise.
Player-level behavioral data are highly sensitive and should not enter a pooled benchmark.
Founder enthusiasm for gambling could create perceived conflicts requiring transparent safeguards.

structure.control_point: independent end-to-end control evidence and protected remediation benchmark
structure.critical_dependency: operator participation under credible public-health and privacy governance

thesis: An independent, privacy-preserving control-evidence system for licensed online bookmakers: it tests self-exclusion, time-out, limit, intervention, and marketing-suppression workflows and publishes only protected aggregate benchmarks. Repeated control failures and remediation outcomes create a defensible assurance dataset without pooling player identities.
title: SaferPlay Controls Evidence Exchange
uncertainties: The exact Polish legal duties for each control and the acceptability of third-party testing require specialist counsel.
The Polish customer count may be too small without an early EU expansion path.
The 65000 PLN capital estimate and all commercial figures below are planning hypotheses.
